description: Side-by-side minimum wages for 2 to 10 US states (or DC) on one date in 2026-2027: standard rate, tipped cash wage, tip credit, effective date and full-time annual pay (40 h x 52 weeks), sorted highest first, with the gap between highest and lowest. State-level only.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD between 2026-01-01 and 2027-12-31. Defaults to today.

items.description: US state name or 2-letter code, or DC. Examples: "California", "TX", "District of Columbia".

name: compare_states
title: Compare state minimum wages
